meta.provenance_note: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE DATA. These records were generated locally to develop and demonstrate the interface. They are not real launches. Run `npm run ingest` to replace them with live records from Launch Library 2.

sources.name: FIXTURE GENERATOR (synthetic — not real data)
sources.detail: Synthetic records generated locally for interface development. Every field is flagged FIXTURE. Run `npm run ingest` without --fixture to replace with live data.

sources.name: r/SpaceX API v4 (archived)
sources.detail: Repository archived 6 June 2026; origin returns TLS 525. Dataset was already frozen in maintenance-only mode from 2024, so even when reachable it served no launches after that point. Not called by the ingest pipeline.

pipeline.detail: Retrieved from FIXTURE GENERATOR (synthetic — not real data)
Raw payloads mapped to typed Launch entities. Records missing id or name dropped.
Records sharing an id. First occurrence kept.
Records with no parseable launch date cannot be placed on a time axis.
Outcome codes the mapping did not recognise, filed as UNKNOWN rather than assumed successful.
Sequential index over the kept set, ordered by launch date. Local to this snapshot.
Rockets, boosters, pads and payloads projected out of the launch payloads. LL2 nests them rather than exposing separate collections.
